title: Everyday Phrases — At the Library
youtube_title: 【睡前英文聽力】📚 實用到圖書館借書自習必備常用英文短句 ｜ 不用背！睡覺聽就會 ｜ 🌱A1 ｜ 💡400句循環聽 ｜ 零基礎也能開口說
youtube_title_en: 400 Everyday English Phrases While You Sleep — At the Library
youtube_description: 睡著學英文！這部影片收錄實用到圖書館借書自習情境對話（每兩句成一組：男聲常速 ➡ 女聲慢速 ➡ 男女連貫），從辦借書證、找書、自習佔位到續借還書，不用背，睡前聽就會。重複播放，讓英文自然進入你的大腦。👍 想學更多生活場景，請留言告訴我！別忘了訂閱+按讚。 #英文聽力 #睡前英文 #LearnEnglish
youtube_description_en: Learn English while you sleep! This video features practical At the Library phrase pairs (each pair: male normal speed → female slow speed → combined dialogue), covering library cards, finding books, studying quietly, renewing and returning. No memorization needed—just listen before bed and absorb naturally. If you want more real-life scenarios, leave a comment! Subscribe and like!

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We do that here for free.
dialogue.zh: 在這裡就可以免費幫你做。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I fill this form now?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What do I do with the card?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt du aɪ du wɪð ðə kɑrd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I lose the card?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does a new card cost money?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So this card is mine now?
dialogue.zh: 這張證現在是我的了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When do you shut the doors?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I free to stay all day?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ fri tu steɪ ɔl deɪ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I only come to read?
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌt ɪf aɪ ˈoʊnli kʌm tu rid?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will I get my coin back?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Beside the doors, on the left.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I refill my cup?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No food in the reading room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I take my calls?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this place is smoke free.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a quiet floor?
dialogue.zh: 你們有安靜的那一層嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I get a study room?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ ɡɛt ə ˈstʌdi rum?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many can use that room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the third floor.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are kids allowed to sit there?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, if an adult stays close.
dialogue.zh: 可以，只要大人留在旁邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where can I charge my phone?
dialogue.zh: 我的手機能在哪裡充電？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the desk for a code.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a lost and found?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ju hæv ə lɔst ənd faʊnd?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I find one title?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I type the author name?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 那個號碼是做什麼用的？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The art books are right here.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 是一本講早期地圖的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you check the back room?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I will look in a minute.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I look in that room?
dialogue.zh: 我能在那個房間查資料嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Am I allowed to take them home?
dialogue.phonetic: /æm aɪ əˈlaʊd tu teɪk ðɛm hoʊm?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have books in English?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: On the low table near the doors.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑn ðə loʊ ˈteɪbəl nɪr ðə dɔrz./

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I read this map?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I want one book for class.
dialogue.zh: 我想要一本上課用的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 功課書那一架就在附近。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two big ones on the desk.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use it in the room, please.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which table is the long one?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The one in the middle room.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I move this chair over?
dialogue.zh: 我可以把這張椅子搬過去嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I found the book at last!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we write in these books?
dialogue.zh: 我們可以在書上寫字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I borrow a small lamp?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us study for one hour.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: May I write on this table?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Draw a line for each part.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I do not get this page.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I read it out loud?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pads are by the big map.
dialogue.zh: 墊板就擺在大地圖那邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us take a short break.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask them to keep it down.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 在這裡連悄悄話都聽得見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Put it deep in your bag.

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is fine, no one minds.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please do not laugh out loud.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I saved a seat for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should I leave my notebook here?
dialogue.zh: 我的筆記本該放這裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do you have a long cord?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I print from a phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ prɪnt frʌm ə foʊn?/

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Show them, they will fix it.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do not take too much paper.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One side is enough for me.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I scan a page too?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let us check out at the machine.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛt ʌs tʃɛk aʊt æt ðə məˈʃin./
dialogue.zh: 我們用自助借書機試試。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then I lay the book flat?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, wait till it turns green.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long can I keep it?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I also get a slip?
dialogue.zh: 能給我一張紙本收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many times can I renew?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if I miss the date?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How much is one day late?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Five cents per book per day.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay at the desk?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will you email me a notice?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the book is damaged?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if my brother spilled juice?
dialogue.zh: 萬一我弟把果汁灑上去呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I pay for a torn page?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ peɪ fər ə tɔrn peɪdʒ?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 這本書已經被人借走了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I ask for one?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long till it comes back?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I wait in a line?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, we keep it for you.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long do you keep it?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Three days, then off it goes.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, how do I return them?

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 不用，螢幕顯示完成就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I give them to the desk?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ ɡɪv ðɛm tu ðə dɛsk?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My friend could bring them back?
dialogue.zh: 我朋友幫我送回來行嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if the book is gone?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I buy a new copy?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next time I want a book on plants.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst taɪm aɪ wɑnt ə bʊk ɑn plænts./
dialogue.zh: 下次我想要一本植物的書。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I print the floor map?
dialogue.zh: 我能把樓層地圖印出來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How many did I take out?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Could I take two more, then?

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a room just for kids?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə rum dʒʌst fər kɪdz?/

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Mind if I rest my eyes?
dialogue.zh: 讓我閉眼休息一下好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.zh: 那是為了防止東西被拿走。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need my card to leave?
dialogue.phonetic: /du aɪ nid maɪ kɑrd tu liv?/
dialogue.zh: 離開時我也要出示證嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I get a list of new books?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ ɡɛt ə lɪst ʌv nu bʊks?/
dialogue.zh: 能給我一份新書清單嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A stand is by the doors.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I will take my notes home.

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.zh: 我們今天到這裡結束嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See you by the front desk.
